name: Tsubame no Sedai
source:
First debut work of PECOLIEN. A short kinetic ADV about a human and an android girl.

Crowdfunding starts on May 1st 2024 to June 30th 2024 on [url=https://camp-fire.jp/projects/688677/preview?token=2a6ys38j]Crowdfunding Campfire Website.[/url]

Hundreds of years after the fall of human civilization due to a large-scale war. A rational and cold-blooded young man who has been living on the battlefield all his life, is attacked and injured by bandits.

Wounded, he takes refuge in an abandoned shelter. There, he meets a certain person. A babysitting android girl manufactured a long, long time ago. Because of her overly meddlesome personality, he gives in and decides to stay with her while recovering from his injures.

This a joyful and emotional story of a human who has forgotten his heart, and an android girl who feels more than a human.

[From [url=https://www.famitsu.com/news/202404/15339022.html]Famitsu[/url]]
translation:
PECOLIEN的首部出道作品。关于人类和机器人女孩的简短动态ADV。

众筹将于2024年5月1日至2024年6月30日在 [url=https://camp-fire.jp/projects/688677/preview?token=2a6ys38j]Crowdfunding Campfire网站[/url] 上开始。

人类文明因大规模战争而衰落数百年后。一生生活在战场上的理性冷血青年，遭土匪袭击受伤。

受伤后，他躲进一个废弃的避难所。在那里，他遇到了某个人。很久很久以前制造的一个保姆机器人女孩。由于她过于爱管闲事的性格，他屈服了，决定留下来陪她养伤。

这是一个关于一个忘记了自己的心的人类和一个比人类更有感觉的机器人女孩的欢乐而感人的故事。

[来自[url=https://www.famitsu.com/news/202404/15339022.html]Fami通[/url]]
